title: JSON.stringify throws on BigInt: serialize it as a string

problem.symptom: TypeError: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt
problem.description: JSON has no BigInt type. Use a replacer that converts bigint values to strings (and parse them back explicitly).

files.lib.cjs: module.exports.toJson = (o) => JSON.stringify(o, (_k, v) => (typeof v === "bigint" ? v.toString() : v));

limitations.proves: BigInt values serialize as exact decimal strings.
limitations.does_not_prove: That consumers parse them back as BigInt.

author: cafe-curator
